description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to a responsive grid system, including both Flexbox and CSS Grid implementations. It provides mixins for creating rows, columns, offsets, and grid columns with breakpoint-specific adjustments.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a flex container with wrapping and gutter margins for a grid row.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares a grid column by setting box-sizing, width, max-width, padding, and margin properties to make it ready for responsive sizing.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines the flex and width properties for a grid column based on the provided size and total columns.

methods.name: make-col-auto
methods.description: Sets a column's flex basis to auto and width to auto for automatic sizing.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Applies a margin-left offset to a column based on the specified size and total columns.

methods.name: row-cols
methods.description: Sets its direct children to span a specified number of columns, using flexbox.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates breakpoint-specific grid classes for flexible layouts, including equal-width columns, auto columns, row columns, offsets, and gutters.

methods.name: make-cssgrid
methods.description: Creates breakpoint-specific CSS grid classes for grid-column and grid-start properties.
